messages.subject: [GenABEL-dev] tutorial for useR 2012
messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

this is to inform you that it turned out that the number of tutorial
session at UseR is very limited, and my application for the GenABEL
tutorial was turned down.

I was at first genuinely surprised by that decision, but given the
space available, and our relatively 'niche' position, this is
reasonable. After all, the base R and mainstream packages are
something for tens to hundreds of thousands of users, while the
GenABEL suite is about few thousands of users.

I am going to submit (almost) the same text as an abstract asking for
an oral presentation.

best wishes,
Yurii

On Sat, Jan 14, 2012 at 12:08 PM, Yury Aulchenko
<yurii.aulchenko at gmail.com> wrote:
> Dear All,
>
> I am going to attend UseR 2012, and have just submitted a tutorial. I attach
> it here FYI; please let me know if you'd like to amend that - there should
> still be a possibility to do that.
>
> I am also thinking of asking for a presentation outlining our project.
>
> Is anybody else going to attend UseR 2012? Would you like to present
> something on GenABEL? Would you like to help me with the tutorial session?
>
> best wishes,
> Yurii
> -------------------------------------------------------
> Yurii Aulchenko, PhD, Dr. Habil.
> Independent researcher and consultant
> yurii [dot] aulchenko [at] gmail?[dot]?com
>
>
>
>



--
